scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run docker:up && turbo run dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm run docker:up && turbo run dev --filter api
scripts.db:reset: corepack pnpm run docker:down -v && corepack pnpm run docker:up
scripts.start:prod:local: corepack pnpm run docker:up && corepack pnpm run docker:wait && turbo run start:prod
scripts.start:prod:local:api: corepack pnpm run docker:up && corepack pnpm run docker:wait && turbo run start:prod --filter api --filter notification-worker
scripts.start:prod:containers: GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) docker compose --profile app --profile o11y up --build
